title: III. Occupancy Rate (in %) of Female State/UT wise comparison of Inmates in Other Jails (Except occupancy rate of female inmates in jails Woman Jails) as on (except Woman Jail) is presented below 31st December, 2016 showing that Chhattisgarh has reported the highest occupancy rate (186.0%) A total 18,498 female inmates were in followed by Uttarakhand (141.5%) and various prisons at national level out of Uttar Pradesh (125.4%). Among other which only 16.9% (3,122) female inmates states, West Bengal (120.7%), Goa were lodged in Woman Jail as on 31st (120.0%) and Jharkhand (99.4%) has December 2016. Around 83.1% of total reported substantial occupancy rate of female inmates (15,376) were lodged in female inmates in other jails (except other type of Jails. woman jail)
